performance.measurement_notes: PP13 DSAPI throughput profile. GLM-5.2-FP8 has 78 main transformer layers and needs enough queued requests to fill the 13-stage layer pipeline. The merged sparse FlashMLA BF16 fallback launch loaded but timed out on a direct one-token smoke request on Spark GB10, so the service baseline now returns to the completed dense TRITON_MLA path with FP8 E4M3 KV, Marlin FP8 MoE, 128 sequences, 32768 batched tokens, 4 GiB fixed KV per rank, eager execution, and overlapped PP TCP tensor-dict sends. The 64-sequence dense baseline reached 64.9 tok/sec for 64 concurrent 64-token outputs with about 1.1% GPU KV usage, so the next usable-throughput target is batch-128 admission without increasing the fixed KV reservation. A prior 128-sequence/65536-token envelope hit NVIDIA driver NV_ERR_NO_MEMORY during CUDA initialization on 8-layer stages. Native SM12 sparse FlashMLA remains the preferred future path once upstream accepts the architecture without the DS4 Triton BF16 fallback.
performance.target: 13-stage GLM-5.2-FP8 frontier throughput pipeline with dense TRITON_MLA, FP8 KV, and no external KV connector.

quality.baseline: Unmeasured. Added for first Spark-ring GLM-5.2-FP8 smoke and ds4-eval testing.
